title: Otto Hardwick's disappearances and 'making bouzan'
summary: Otto Hardwick often missed nights; when Bigard went along, Hardwick ran from apartment to apartment drinking until Bigard missed the job.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: When Duke and the small unit would go up to New England in the summertime, what were you doing? That was during the period you were --
I wasn't there. I wasn't in New York at all.

You see, I was -- that was after I joined Duke. And during the summer I used to go up in the New England states when he had the big band, see, and that's when he used to tell all the stories about Sidney and Bubber Miley and Otto Hardwick -- that's another one.
Why did Otto Hardwick leave the band?

I think he left by request. In other words, it's a funny thing, when I joined the band, Otto Hardwick, he wouldn't show up sometimes for two and three nights and I always wondered what is he doing. I knew he was a heavy drinker.

So one night I decided I'm going to hang out with him and find out what he's doing, you know. Then he called me, 'Let's go make bouzan.' I taught him how to say that -- bouzan. Let's go have a ball with drinking. He said, 'You going to make bouzan with me tonight?' I said, 'Yeah, I'm
with you." All he did was run from apartment to -- all of his friends, lady friends -- apartment to apartment, drinking and drinking until he got stoned. He got me so stoned I missed the night.
I says, "Oh, no." I couldn't believe it, but that's what he used to do and for no rhyme or reason. He'd just go out.
